public_source.title: What Is Certificate Transparency?
observations: Sectigo states that publicly trusted certificates are submitted to publicly accessible CT logs that return signed timestamps.
Sectigo describes CT logs as independently operated, append-only Merkle-tree databases whose entries can be verified.
Sectigo names crt.sh as a tool for reading/auditing CT log data.
Sectigo states that it operates its own CT logs and sponsors other parties to operate separate logs.

slice.finding: The official static page is a valid operator-level witness that Sectigo participates as a CT log operator and that CT log contents are intended to be publicly auditable.
